root: ^A young lady? What are you doing here, the show did not started yet!
^Would you be kind enough to let this boy go? His brother is worried sick...
^But I need him for my knife throiwng act!
^Ever since I lost my memory cards knife throwing is the only way for me to dazzle the audience with my eye of an eagle!
^And what could make it more engaging than throwing knives at a living target?
^If you keep throwing these knives at me, I won't be a 'living' target for long!!!
^Sir, if I help you find your cards, will you let him go?
